summary: Waldencast plc filed a 6-K attaching its H1 2026 results and business update, disclosing completion on July 30, 2026 of the sale of its Obagi Medical business to Bridgepoint, closing a strategic review. The disposal was classified as held for sale and reported as discontinued operations. Net cash proceeds were $149.9 million, used to repay $178.4 million of Lumina Credit Agreement indebtedness in full; continuing-operations cash was $138.6 million at August 31, 2026. Obagi's remaining operations now center on Milk Makeup (H1 revenue $26.1 million). Watch shareholder approval mechanics and post-close overhead reduction execution.
